title: Explicit pair-groupoid thickening of a quasicategory
statement:
Use small simplicial sets, degreewise products, nerves, quasicategories, coherent functor categories and functor equivalences as in [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], in a fixed universe. Let $X$ be a small set with a specified element $x_0$, and let $I$ be a small quasicategory. Let $E_X$ be the ordinary category whose objects are $X$ and whose morphism set between any ordered pair of objects is a singleton, with the unique possible identities and compositions. Write $J_X=N(E_X)$, so $(J_X)_n=X^{n+1}$ and operators delete or repeat coordinates, and put $K=I\times J_X$. Then $J_X$ is a Kan complex and $K$ is a small quasicategory. The projection $p:K\to I$ is a coherent functor equivalence with quasi-inverse $s:I\to K$ given in degree $n$ by $\sigma\mapsto(\sigma,(x_0,\ldots,x_0))$; one has $ps=\mathrm{id}_I$. There is a coherent natural equivalence $\eta:sp\to\mathrm{id}_K$ whose associated simplicial map $K\times\Delta^1\to K$ is
$$((\sigma,(y_0,\ldots,y_n)),\alpha:[n]\to[1])\longmapsto(\sigma,(z_0,\ldots,z_n)),$$
Here $z_k=x_0$ if $\alpha(k)=0$, and $z_k=y_k$ if $\alpha(k)=1$. It satisfies $p\eta=p\operatorname{pr}_K$. No filteredness assumption is imposed on $I$, and $I$ may be empty.
